entries.title: Sunday Shakshuka
entries.verdict: The reason we own a cast-iron pan.
entries.review:
Slow-cooked tomatoes, a frankly irresponsible amount of cumin and smoked paprika, and eggs pulled the second the whites set. Crumbled feta and a fistful of cilantro on top.

Niv insists on mopping it up with challah; Amanda is team sourdough. Both are correct. Next time: add roasted red peppers and make double.

entries.title: Taco Truck Night
entries.verdict: Two orders, eight dollars each, zero regrets.
entries.review:
Amanda went classic: al pastor shaved straight off the trompo with a sliver of pineapple caught mid-air. Niv got the birria, dunked in a cup of rich consommé until the tortillas went soft and red.

The tortillas are pressed to order and the salsa verde has real heat. The line is long after 10pm, but it moves fast. Grab extra napkins — you will need them.

entries.title: Anniversary Tasting Menu
entries.review:
Eleven courses, each one prettier than the last. The scallop with brown butter and the tiny chocolate soufflé were genuine highlights.

Niv's review, verbatim: "The portions were the size of a postage stamp and I stopped for a slice of pizza on the way home." This one is officially a hot debate.
